card.name: Words just before 2000s news events
card.fires_on: Small linking words or punctuation just before or inside a named mid-2000s event, such as the Sichuan earthquake, the Gleneagles G8 summit, or the 2004 Bush-Kerry election, in general web text.

modes.label: Before a named disaster or summit
modes.description: A small word like "the", "at" or "on" right before a place-linked event from 2005-2008.
modes.example: as the OECD has reported that many rich countries have cut back on their foreign aid budgets, with little sign that the pledge made at the G8 summit<< at>> Gleneagles in 20

modes.label: Inside lists or pairs of names
modes.description: A comma, "and", or hyphen between named storms, politicians or candidates from the same period.
modes.example: As Germany prepares to elect its next Chancellor, the two main candidates, Gerhard Schroeder<< and>> Edmund Stoiber, agree on one thing

card.writes: It pushes Bush, the Sichuan earthquake (汶川) and mid-2000s Chinese political slogans, and suppresses newer 2010s slogans and terms such as crowdfunding and WeChat.
card.plain: It fires on small linking words just before a mid-2000s news event or name, nudging the model toward that era's vocabulary.
